app.name: Review marble evidence
app.description: Does a fixed weighing record establish the bag containing the heavy marble? Exactly one of nine identified marbles is heavier. Generate each possible heavy identity, derive each weighing outcome from its pan membership, and retain assignments within the declared global report-error limit, initially one. The required bag question and optional exact-identity question are assessed independently from the generated interpretations. These are hypothetical observations, not a record of physical inspection or permission to act.
app.source:
# Canonical evidence-review/1 model. Rules and presentation are data.
format: evidence-review/1
module:
  id: marble-evidence
  version: "1.2.0"
  title: Review marble evidence
  metadata:
    catalog:
      domain:
        id: canonical-examples
        label: Canonical examples
        description: Reference problems for understanding and testing reusable evidence patterns.
      useCase:
        id: locate-heavy-marble
        label: Locate a heavy marble
        description: Determine whether a weighing record identifies the containing bag or the exact heavy marble.
  description: "Does a fixed weighing record establish the bag containing the heavy marble? Exactly one of nine identified marbles is heavier. Generate each possible heavy identity, derive each weighing outcome from its pan membership, and retain assignments within the declared global report-error limit, initially one. The required bag question and optional exact-identity question are assessed independently from the generated interpretations. These are hypothetical observations, not a record of physical inspection or permission to act."
  question: "Does this record establish which bag contains the heavy marble?"
  boundary: "Nine listed marbles in inventory N1; stable bag membership and masses; one known-heavier marble; equal normal masses; equal-size disjoint pans; containers ignored; at most the declared number of incorrect reports across the complete record. Unlisted marbles, changed layouts, transient masses and probabilistic report errors are outside this model."
  assumptions: ["Exactly one listed marble is heavier; all others have equal mass.", "Physical outcomes are determined from the heavy marble’s side in an equal-size weighing.", "The error limit applies globally to the submitted record, not separately to each setup.", "Logical compatibility supplies no probabilities, entropy or information gain."]
  parameters:
    - id: maxIncorrectReports
      type: integer
      min: 0
      max: 20
      default: 1
  relations:
    - id: inventory
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: id
          type: string
      key: [id]
    - id: bag
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: id
          type: string
        - id: label
          type: string
      key: [id]
    - id: marble
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: id
          type: string
        - id: bag
          type: string
          references:
            relation: bag
            column: id
        - id: inventory
          type: string
          references:
            relation: inventory
            column: id
      key: [id]
    - id: outcome
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: id
          type: string
      key: [id]
    - id: setup
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: id
          type: string
        - id: inventory
          type: string
          references:
            relation: inventory
            column: id
      key: [id]
    - id: pan
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: setup
          type: string
          references:
            relation: setup
            column: id
        - id: marble
          type: string
          references:
            relation: marble
            column: id
        - id: side
          type: string
      key: [setup, marble]
    - id: observation
      source: evidence
      columns:
        - id: id
          type: string
        - id: setup
          type: string
          references:
            relation: setup
            column: id
        - id: inventory
          type: string
          references:
            relation: inventory
            column: id
        - id: reported
          type: string
          references:
            relation: outcome
            column: id
      key: [id]
    - id: heavy
      source: assignment
      columns:
        - id: marble
          type: string
          references:
            relation: marble
            column: id
      key: [marble]
    - id: prediction
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: setup
          type: string
        - id: outcome
          type: string
      key: [setup]
    - id: mismatch
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: observation
          type: string
        - id: expected
          type: string
        - id: reported
          type: string
      key: [observation]
  generation:
    - id: GENERATE.HEAVY
      relation: heavy
      from:
        relation: marble
        column: id
      min: 1
      max: 1
  rules:
    - id: PREDICT.LEFT
      head:
        relation: prediction
        args: ["?setup", left]
      body:
        - relation: heavy
          args: ["?marble"]
        - relation: pan
          args: ["?setup", "?marble", left]
    - id: PREDICT.RIGHT
      head:
        relation: prediction
        args: ["?setup", right]
      body:
        - relation: heavy
          args: ["?marble"]
        - relation: pan
          args: ["?setup", "?marble", right]
    - id: PREDICT.BALANCED
      head:
        relation: prediction
        args: ["?setup", balanced]
      body:
        - relation: setup
          args: ["?setup", "?inventory"]
        - relation: heavy
          args: ["?marble"]
        - not:
            relation: pan
            args: ["?setup", "?marble", left]
        - not:
            relation: pan
            args: ["?setup", "?marble", right]
    - id: REPORT.MISMATCH
      head:
        relation: mismatch
        args: ["?id", "?predicted", "?reported"]
      body:
        - relation: observation
          args: ["?id", "?setup", "?inventory", "?reported"]
        - relation: prediction
          args: ["?setup", "?predicted"]
        - op: ne
          args: ["?predicted", "?reported"]
  admission:
    - id: PAN.SIDES
      label: Every pan entry names left or right
      when:
        - relation: pan
          args: ["?setup", "?marble", "?side"]
      assert:
        op: ne
        args: ["?side", balanced]
    - id: PAN.KNOWN_SIDE
      label: Every pan entry uses a supported side
      when:
        - relation: pan
          args: ["?setup", "?marble", "?side"]
      assert:
        op: exists
        atom:
          relation: outcome
          args: ["?side"]
    - id: PAN.EQUAL
      label: Each setup compares equally many marbles
      when:
        - relation: setup
          args: ["?setup", "?inventory"]
        - count:
            relation: pan
            args: ["?setup", "?m", left]
          as: "?left"
        - count:
            relation: pan
            args: ["?setup", "?n", right]
          as: "?right"
      assert:
        op: eq
        args: ["?left", "?right"]
    - id: PAN.NONEMPTY
      label: Each setup compares nonempty groups
      when:
        - relation: setup
          args: ["?setup", "?inventory"]
        - count:
            relation: pan
            args: ["?setup", "?m", left]
          as: "?left"
      assert:
        op: gt
        args: ["?left", 0]
    - id: PAN.INVENTORY
      label: The pan contents belong to the setup inventory
      when:
        - relation: pan
          args: ["?setup", "?marble", "?side"]
        - relation: setup
          args: ["?setup", "?setupInventory"]
        - relation: marble
          args: ["?marble", "?bag", "?marbleInventory"]
      assert:
        op: eq
        args: ["?setupInventory", "?marbleInventory"]
    - id: RECORD.INVENTORY
      label: "Each observation uses its setup’s inventory"
      when:
        - relation: observation
          args: ["?id", "?setup", "?inventory", "?reported"]
        - relation: setup
          args: ["?setup", "?setupInventory"]
      assert:
        op: eq
        args: ["?inventory", "?setupInventory"]
  constraints:
    - id: GLOBAL.REPORT.LIMIT
      label: Predicted and reported outcomes differ within the global error limit
      when:
        - count:
            relation: mismatch
            args: ["?id", "?expected", "?reported"]
          as: "?errors"
      assert:
        op: lte
        args:
          - "?errors"
          - parameter: maxIncorrectReports
  queries:
    - id: containing-bag
      label: Containing bag
      kind: value
      body:
        - relation: heavy
          args: ["?marble"]
        - relation: marble
          args: ["?marble", "?bag", "?inventory"]
      select: ["?bag"]
    - id: heavy-marble
      label: Exact heavy marble
      kind: value
      body:
        - relation: heavy
          args: ["?marble"]
      select: ["?marble"]
  reports:
    tables:
      - id: heavy
        label: Heavy identity
        relation: heavy
        columns: [marble]
      - id: predictions
        label: Predicted setup outcomes
        relation: prediction
        columns: [setup, outcome]
      - id: mismatches
        label: Reports using the error allowance
        relation: mismatch
        columns: [observation, expected, reported]
  presentation:
    findingGroups:
      - id: bag-identification
        title: Bag identification
        question: "Which bag contains the heavy marble?"
        description: Assess the bag-selection question without requiring the exact heavy marble to be identified.
        queryIds: [containing-bag]
      - id: marble-identification
        title: Marble identification
        question: "Which individual marble is heavy?"
        description: Assess the finer identity question separately from the containing-bag answer.
        queryIds: [heavy-marble]
case:
  id: E3
  scope: "Inventory N1 / stable weighing record O1–O3"
  parameters:
    maxIncorrectReports: 1
  basis:
    inventory:
      - id: N1
    bag:
      - id: red
        label: Red
      - id: blue
        label: Blue
      - id: gold
        label: Gold
    marble:
      - id: r1
        bag: red
        inventory: N1
      - id: r2
        bag: red
        inventory: N1
      - id: r3
        bag: red
        inventory: N1
      - id: b1
        bag: blue
        inventory: N1
      - id: b2
        bag: blue
        inventory: N1
      - id: b3
        bag: blue
        inventory: N1
      - id: g1
        bag: gold
        inventory: N1
      - id: g2
        bag: gold
        inventory: N1
      - id: g3
        bag: gold
        inventory: N1
    outcome:
      - id: left
      - id: right
      - id: balanced
    setup:
      - id: W0
        inventory: N1
      - id: W1
        inventory: N1
    pan:
      - setup: W0
        marble: r1
        side: left
      - setup: W0
        marble: r2
        side: left
      - setup: W0
        marble: r3
        side: left
      - setup: W0
        marble: b1
        side: right
      - setup: W0
        marble: b2
        side: right
      - setup: W0
        marble: b3
        side: right
      - setup: W1
        marble: r1
        side: left
      - setup: W1
        marble: r2
        side: right
  evidence:
    observation:
      - id: O1
        setup: W0
        inventory: N1
        reported: left
      - id: O2
        setup: W0
        inventory: N1
        reported: right
      - id: O3
        setup: W0
        inventory: N1
        reported: left
  queryIds: [containing-bag, heavy-marble]
  evaluation:
    maxCandidates: 10000
    maxRuleRounds: 100
    maxFacts: 50000

definitionContract.title: Establish the required answer
definitionContract.responsibility: Generate interpretations from declared finite rules, retain evidence-compatible alternatives, and test stability of the required answer.
invariants: Establishment requires a nonempty admissible basis and a completed counterexample check.
Different admissible answers demonstrate underdetermination even before enumeration completes.
An empty interrupted search does not establish inconsistency.
A Boolean false answer can be established. Counts do not imply probabilities.
Results are relative to the authored finite model, submitted evidence and exact query.
